text:
emma: quick post-all-hands thread on GPU capacity, region rollout, and autoscaler fallbacks. keeping it short.
raj: APAC ETA for T4 pilot? teams need a testing window.
emma: target mid-July for APAC T4 burst pilot; reserved Dedicated targets late Q3. we'll publish exact zones next week.
lisa: autoscaler pool order? need to configure latency-sensitive routes.
emma: order = reserved -> prewarm -> burst (spot/partners) -> model fallback (quantized/smaller). reserved preferred to protect p95.
david: if spot/burst gets evicted, what happens to inflight requests?
emma: eviction flow: 1) immediate try reserved/prewarm 2) switch to quantized/smaller model 3) short queue (200ms) then fail if no path. we avoid dropping if possible.
marcos: ops needs concrete prewarm guidance for cloud provisioning. any formula?
emma: suggested calc: prewarm_slots = ceil(route_qps * p95_s * 1.5). default per-major-region: 150 slots; APAC pilot: start 50 and scale.
jen: sample autoscaler config we can share? TTLs and cooldowns.
emma: example below for teams to copy: ```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 2
  prewarm_pool_slots: 50
  burst_threshold_qps: 100
  scale_up_cooldown_s: 30
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 300
  eviction_retry_ms: 200
  fallback_order: [reserved, prewarm, burst, quant-1.3b]
```
raj: billing question: will prewarm show up separately for hosted PAYG?
emma: yes — hosted PAYG will have a "prewarm" line item; Dedicated includes prewarm in the commit. we'll add an opt-out per route.
lisa: region prioritization when supply is constrained? EU-first for some customers.
emma: routing uses region weight + customer tier; enterprise SLA routes get in-region priority; PLG can overflow cross-region if allowed.
marcos: can infra publish a one-page GPU-pressure playbook and on-call matrix?
emma: action: infra to publish "GPU pressure playbook" by Friday. owner: marcos. will include alerts, paging, and mitigation steps.
ops-bot: notes + deck uploaded -> https://redwood.company/all-hands/2026-03-20 (deck v10.3). :spiral_notepad:
emma: scheduling a 30m follow-up sync Tue 10am PT to collect route lists and sizing. invite from marcos. DM me any latency-critical routes.
raj: thanks, useful.
emma: closing — playbook, deck link, autoscaler example, and sync invite incoming. :thumbsup:
